# HealthPlus by SEHA Medical — Midnapore Primary, Walk-In & Specialist Medical Centre (Calgary, AB)

> **HealthPlus by SEHA Medical** is a comprehensive, multidisciplinary medical clinic located at **100-290 Midpark Way SE, Midnapore, Calgary, AB T2X 1P1**. Operating as the South Calgary flagship hub of the SEHA Medical Network, HealthPlus brings together **11 Family Physicians**, a **6-Day Walk-In Medical Clinic**, and **5 In-House Specialist Consultants** (Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Internal Medicine & Infectious Diseases, Psychiatry, and Sport & Exercise Medicine) under one roof.

## Direct Contact, Hours & Online Booking
- **Address**: Suite 100, 290 Midpark Way SE, Calgary, AB T2X 1P1, Canada (Free surface parking)
- **GPS Coordinates**: 50.9098, -114.0631
- **Telephone**: (403) 455-6656
- **Clinical & Specialist Referral Fax**: (403) 648-1876
- **Administrative Email (Non-Clinical)**: admin@healthplusmed.ca
- **Online Appointment Request Form**: https://form.jotform.com/sehamanagementinv/-appointment-request-form
- **Online Call-Back Request Form**: https://form.jotform.com/sehamanagementinv/call-back-request-form
- **Opening Hours (Walk-In & Scheduled)**:
  - Monday – Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM
  - Friday: 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  - Saturday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  - Sunday & Statutory Holidays: Closed
- **South Calgary Communities Served**: Midnapore, Sundance, Chaparral, Shawnessy, Somerset, Bridlewood, Millrise, Evergreen, Legacy, Walden, McKenzie Lake, McKenzie Towne, Cranston, Mahogany, Seton, Canyon Meadows, Parkland, Lake Bonavista, and Okotoks.

## 16 CPSA-Licensed Physicians & Specialists

### 11 Family Physicians (Accepting New Patients & Walk-Ins)
- **Dr. Aous Al Shehabi** (MD · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Practicing medicine for over 22 years across emergency, inpatient, and community family practice, including 8 years in British Columbia prior to joining HealthPlus Calgary. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-1
- **Dr. Elhadi Mohammed** (MD, CCFP · Family Physician & Hospitalist) — *Family Physician*: Canadian licensed Family Physician (CCFP) with clinical experience in Ireland and British Columbia, also serving as a Hospitalist at Foothills Medical Centre in Calgary. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-5
- **Dr. Hatim Kheir** (MD, MRCGP, DRCOG, DFSRH · Medical Director) — *Family Physician & Medical Director*: UK-trained Family Physician (MRCGP, DRCOG, DFSRH) and Medical Director with expertise in acute care, chronic disease management, women's health, and minor surgical procedures. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-6
- **Dr. May Aldabbagh** (MD · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Licensed Family Physician at HealthPlus by SEHA Medical in Midnapore, providing compassionate primary care, preventive health screenings, and ongoing family medicine. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-7
- **Dr. Mehwish Hanif** (MD, CCFP · University of Calgary) — *Family Physician*: University of Calgary Medical School graduate (MD, CCFP) specializing in comprehensive family medicine, women's health, contraception & IUD care, and mental well-being. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-8
- **Dr. Nour Bukhres** (MD, CCFP · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Canadian licensed Family Physician (CCFP) with four years of family, hospital, and emergency medicine experience in Northern British Columbia prior to relocating to Calgary. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-9
- **Dr. Oladotun Oyediran** (MD · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Licensed Family Physician at HealthPlus by SEHA Medical in Midnapore, dedicated to accessible primary care, walk-in consultations, and long-term chronic disease management. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-10
- **Dr. Radhya Aboaziza** (MD · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Licensed Family Physician at HealthPlus by SEHA Medical in Midnapore, offering patient-centred primary care, women's health, and family wellness across all life stages. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-11
- **Dr. Sandeep Kumar** (MBBS, MRCGP (UK), PgDip Clinical Dermatology) — *Family Physician*: UK-trained Family Physician (MRCGP) with 15+ years of clinical experience and a Postgraduate Diploma in Clinical Dermatology from the University of South Wales. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-12
- **Dr. Ahmed Enbya** (MD, CCFP · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Family Physician with over 10 years of patient-centred primary care experience and a 2025 BCCFP My Family Doctor Award nomination. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-15
- **Dr. Sidra Feroz** (MBBS · Family Medicine) — *Family Physician*: Family Physician with a special interest in women's health, preventive care, and compassionate community-based medicine for individuals and families. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-16

### 5 In-House Specialist Consultants (By Physician Referral — Fax 403-648-1876)
- **Dr. Angela Vinturache** (MD, PhD · Obstetrics & Gynecology) — *Obstetrics & Gynecology Specialist*: Obstetrician-Gynecologist and clinician-scientist trained in Oxford, London, and Dublin, providing comprehensive reproductive, prenatal, and menopause care. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-0
- **Dr. Asaad Qaddori** (MD, CCFP (EM), Dip. Sport Med (CASEM)) — *Sport Medicine Specialist*: University of Calgary Fellowship-trained Sport and Exercise Medicine Physician (Dip. Sport Med, CASEM) with background in Emergency Medicine and Orthopedic training. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-2
- **Dr. Bhavisha Ramsamy** (MBBCh, FCPaed (SA), MMed (Paed), DCH) — *Pediatrician*: Specialist Pediatrician (MMed Pediatrics, FCPaed) with over 10 years of experience in child health, newborn care, and developmental pediatrics. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-4
- **Dr. Tariq Khan** (MD, MRCPsych (UK) · Consultant Psychiatrist) — *Consultant Psychiatrist*: UK- and Canada-trained Consultant Psychiatrist, former CAMH Staff Psychiatrist and University of Toronto Assistant Professor specializing in adult psychiatry and ADHD. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-13
- **Dr. Tyral Ramsamy** (MBBCh, FCP (SA), MMed (Int Med), Cert ID, DTM&H) — *Internal Medicine & Infectious Diseases Consultant*: Internal Medicine and Infectious Diseases Consultant (FCP, MMed, Cert ID, DTM&H Sheffield) specializing in complex adult medical diagnostics and chronic disease management. Profile: https://healthplusmed.ca/team/dr-14
